parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left cabinet door of a storage cabinet, made of wood with a smooth finish and glass panels.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable barrier to open or close the cabinet, providing access to the interior storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally along a track to open or close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right cabinet door of a storage cabinet, made of wood with glass panels matching the left door.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the left door to enclose the cabinet’s contents and can be slid open for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally along a track opposite to the left door.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of wood, providing support for doors and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together, ensuring stability and rigidity of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper shelf inside the cabinet, made of wood, designed to hold stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a flat surface for organizing and supporting objects within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower shelf inside the cabinet, made of wood, similar to the upper shelf.
parts.Functional_description: It supports heavier or larger items stored in the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.
